import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
marker = time.time_ns()
results = {'reconciliation': {'input_rows': 3, 'used_rows': 2, 'excluded': [{'reason': 'missing amount', 'rows': 1}]}, 'values': {'run_marker': marker}}
Path('output').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Path('output/results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, sort_keys=True))
Path('output/report.md').write_text(f'Run {marker}')
